kebab_example: aliyun rtc start-streaming-out --app-id 'eo85****' --channel-id testid --template-id 567 --url rtmp://example.com/live/stream --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartStreamingOut

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of an existing channel. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 已存在的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The template ID
parameters.help_zh: 模版ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The live stream ingest URL. Only a single URL is supported. This URL cannot be used by multiple tasks at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 直播推流地址，仅支持传单个地址。该地址不可多个任务同时使用
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The task ID of the bypass streaming task. Only a single ID is supported. The ID can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and can be up to 55 bytes in length. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates a task ID
parameters.help_zh: 本次旁路推流的任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字节，不填，则由系统自动生成
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The crop mode. Valid values:
1: Crop the image while maintaining the aspect ratio.
2: Maintain the aspect ratio and add borders (default).
3: Stretch the image to fill the pane
parameters.help_zh:
裁剪方式。取值：
1：保持比例裁剪。
2：保持比例留边（默认值）。
3：拉伸铺满
parameters.name: crop_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to reserve a pane placeholder for users who do not push camera streams. Default value: true. A value of true indicates that a pane is reserved when a user does not push a camera stream. A value of false indicates that no pane is reserved
parameters.help_zh:
未推摄像头流用户窗格占位。
默认为true，表示用户未推摄像头流时保留一个窗格。
为false时，表示用户未推摄像头流时不保留窗格
parameters.name: reserve_pane_for_no_camera_user

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the default background image of a pane when the user is muted. Valid values:
true: Displays the default background image (default).
false: Does not display the default background image, but the configured local pane background image is still displayed
parameters.help_zh:
mute时是否显示窗格默认底图。
true: 显示（默认值）
false: 不显示（设置的局部窗格底图依然显示）
parameters.name: show_default_background_on_mute

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to subscribe to high resolution streams. Valid values:
false: Subscribes to streams of different resolutions based on the pane area (default).
true: Uses the highest resolution stream pushed by the client for padding by default
parameters.help_zh:
订阅高分辨率流。
false：根据窗格面积订阅不同分辨率的流。（默认值）
true：默认用客户端推的最高分辨率的流进行填充
parameters.name: sub_high_resolution_stream

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow starting the task when the channel does not exist. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许频道不存在时开启任务。

true: 是
false: 否（默认值）
parameters.name: start_without_channel

parameters.help_en: The wait time for the task when the channel is not started, in seconds. This parameter is valid only when the StartWithoutChannel parameter is set to true. Valid values: 30 to 120
parameters.help_zh: 当StartWithoutChannel参数为true的时候，设置该值才有意义，表示房间未开启时，任务等待时长，单位为秒，区间限制为[30,120]
parameters.name: start_without_channel_wait_time

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to reserve the pane for users who have not joined the meeting.
Default value: true. This value indicates that when the specific user or wildcard user specified for the grid is offline, the pane is forcibly reserved.
A value of false indicates that when the specific user or wildcard user specified for the grid is offline, video streams are displayed based on the automatic fill order

未入会用户窗格占位。
默认为true，表示宫格指定的具体用户或通配符用户离线时，窗格强制占位。
为false时，表示宫格指定的具体用户或通配符用户离线时，将按自动填充顺序显示视频流
fields.name: reserve_pane_for_offline_user

fields.help_en:
The media source of the pane. You can specify a userId. To specify a specific user type, you can use wildcard configurations. The following types are supported:
$ActiveSpeaker: The current speaker in the channel.
$ScreenShare: The user who is sharing their screen. If multiple users are sharing their screens in the channel, the panes are filled in chronological order
fields.help_zh:
单元格媒体源。可指定userId，如需指定特定用户类型。可使用通配符配置，支持以下类型。

$ActiveSpeaker：当前频道发言人
$ScreenShare： 屏幕共享用户，当频道中有多个屏幕共享时，将按照先后顺序依次填充

black: Blacklist.

fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The specified user list for layout generation, including Blacklist/Whitelist.

Whitelist: specifies the users whose video streams are subscribed to in the channel.
After the settings are applied, automatic padding is performed in sequence based on this list.
When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users in the whitelist are considered.

Blacklist: specifies the users whose video streams are not subscribed to in the channel.
When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users not in the blacklist are considered
parameters.help_zh:
布局生成用户指定列表，包括黑/白名单两种。

白名单，指定订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
设置后自动填充根据该列表进行顺序填充
模版多布局切换时只计算白名单中的人

黑名单，指定不订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
模版多布局切换时只计算非黑名单中的人
parameters.name: layout_specified_users
